description_zh: 创建一条端口转发规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo create-port --frontend-port 55 --frontend-protocol tcp --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-st21zbyq0000 --real-servers 1.XX.XX.1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePort

parameters.help_en: The forward port. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.name: frontend_port

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding protocol type. Valid values:

tcp: TCP protocol.
udp: UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：

tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: frontend_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to which the port forwarding rule belongs.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
端口转发规则所属的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The origin server port. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.name: backend_port

parameters.help_en: The list of origin server IP addresses
parameters.name: real_servers

parameters.help_en:
The traffic redirection switch. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
引流开关。取值：
0 关闭。
1  开启
parameters.name: proxy_enable

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
